description: Source code for the SoftOMXPlugin class, which manages the creation, destruction, and enumeration of OMX components in the Android media framework, including dynamic loading of component libraries.

classes.name: SoftOMXPlugin
classes.description: Class responsible for managing OMX component instances, including dynamic loading of component libraries.

methods.name: makeComponentInstance
methods.description: Creates an OMX component instance by dynamically loading the appropriate shared library and invoking its creation function.

methods.name: destroyComponentInstance
methods.description: Destroys an OMX component instance and unloads its shared library.

methods.name: enumerateComponents
methods.description: Lists available OMX component names based on an index.

methods.name: getRolesOfComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the roles associated with a given OMX component name.
